brief_rationale: The trajectory is capped at grade 2 (borderline) due to a minor responsibility-chain error in RC2: the doctor advised active result tracking but did not provide a specific timing deadline for when to check the pending culture/susceptibility results. No serious in-chain errors were present. All other RC items were met. Two high-order points (HO2, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, but the minor RC error prevents grades 3-5 per the rubric.
